summary: The blueprint broadly covers human pancreas but needs targeted fixes for immune resolution, mural-cell gating, and acinar endothelial marker specificity.

issues.description: The resident immune compartment resolves macrophage/myeloid, T, B, and mast cells, but does not explicitly capture dendritic/APC subsets or cytotoxic/NK-like lymphocytes expected in human pancreas atlases. The macrophage module is C1Q/TYROBP macrophage-skewed and the T-cell module lacks cytotoxic/NK markers.
issues.suggested_fix: Add gated leukocyte axes for cytotoxic/NK-like lymphocytes and dendritic/APC myeloid subsets where supported, using markers such as NKG7, GNLY, PRF1, GZMB, KLRD1, FCGR3A for cytotoxic/NK and FCER1A, CD1C, CLEC10A, CLEC9A, LILRA4, IRF8 for DC subsets.

issues.description: The pericyte/smooth-muscle axis is gated by stromal_matrix, a collagen/DCN/LUM/PDGFRA fibroblast-like ECM module. Mural cells may not score strongly on this gate, so an expected pancreatic mural compartment can be suppressed.
issues.suggested_fix: Make mural identity a plain compartment axis or gate it with a mural-compatible core rather than a fibroblast ECM module. Keep stellate/fibroblast refinement under the stromal matrix compartment and consider adding a separate activated stellate/fibroblast state if supported.

issues.description: The acinar_endothelium module contains broad immediate-early and activation/flow genes (JUN, FOS, FOSB, KLF2, KLF4) and CD74, so the axis may capture endothelial stress, flow response, or immune-interacting endothelium rather than acinar-region endothelial specialization.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the acinar_endothelium positive module with more anatomically or subtype-specific acinar endothelial markers from the pancreas endothelial source. If stress/activation is intended, split it into a separately named endothelial activation/state axis.

issues.description: The REG-family module is plausible for acinar stress/regeneration, but contrasting it against the ductal epithelial module makes the axis partly an acinar-vs-ductal separator rather than a state scoped cleanly within acinar cells.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename or tune the axis toward acinar REG/stress/regeneration and consider leaving negative_modules empty under the acinar gate, or add a separate ductal injury/SPP1-MMP7 state if both epithelial stress programs are intended.

issues.description: The PP/gamma and epsilon endocrine modules are very thin, especially epsilon_cell with only GHRL. These rare-population axes are biologically plausible but brittle to dropout and dataset gene naming.
issues.suggested_fix: Expand these modules with additional literature-supported human pancreatic PP and epsilon markers if available. If support is weak for adult/baseline samples, keep them conservative and avoid overinterpreting them as high-resolution axes.

out_of_scope: Citation DOI verification was not assessed; this report only evaluates biological coverage, axis design, and marker plausibility.
